#NEXUS

begin taxa;
	dimensions ntax=15;
	taxlabels
        a b c e f g h i j k l m n o p
	;
end;

BEGIN TREES;
    TRANSLATE
         1 a,
         2 b,
         3 c,
         4 e,
         5 f,
         6 g,
         7 h,
         8 i,
         9 j,
        10 k,
        11 l,
        12 m,
        13 n,
        14 o,
        15 p
    ;
    TREE 1 = ((8:17, (9:3, 10:3)4:14)2:33, ((11:6, 12:6)6:30, (13:23, (14:11, 15:11)7:12)5:13)3:14)1:15;
END;
